prompt: Her long brown hair lifts and drifts across her cheek in a light breeze while she keeps her eyes lowered, then blinks once. The camera pushes in very slowly towards her face. Soft overcast daylight stays even on her skin as the grass behind sways out of focus. Quiet, intimate, a little wistful.
title: Windblown Portrait

prompt: The man in the black shirt raises the camera to chest height and turns the lens ring, glancing down at the turntable on the counter. The camera slides gently to the right at counter level. The ring light glows steadily and throws a soft highlight across the wooden surface. Focused, practical, behind the scenes.
title: Studio Setup

prompt: Thin steam lifts from the rim of the glazed mug in slow, soft ribbons and thins as it climbs. The camera holds still, with the faintest drift of focus on the rim. Window light behind the mug brightens and dims slightly as if a cloud passes. Calm, warm, unhurried.
title: Steam Rising

prompt: The two candle flames lean, stretch and settle as a faint draught passes, and the melted wax around the nearer wick shivers. The camera holds still. Warm orange light pulses softly on the candle rim while the room behind stays dark and blurred. Hushed, close, contemplative.
title: Candle Flicker

prompt: The white clouds billow and roll from left to right, their edges curling and thinning against the deep blue. The camera holds still, tilted upward. Sunlight moves across the cloud tops so the bright faces slowly swell and the shadowed undersides deepen. Open, airy, steady.
title: Drifting Clouds

prompt: The leaves of the tree canopy shimmer and the thinner branches sway as a breeze moves through from the left. The camera tilts up very slowly along the trunk. Pale sky flickers through the gaps in the foliage, keeping the black and white tones crisp. Still, graphic, reflective.
title: Monochrome Canopy

prompt: The grey tabby cat narrows its amber eye in a slow blink, its whiskers twitch and one ear turns a fraction towards a sound. The camera pushes in gently towards the eye. Soft daylight from the side keeps a small catchlight glinting in the pupil. Relaxed, tender, drowsy.
title: Slow Cat Blink

prompt: The black and tan dog lowers its head a little further, blinks heavily and lets out a slow breath that flares its nostrils. The camera holds still at eye level. Warm afternoon light rests on its muzzle while the pale background stays soft. Gentle, patient, a little melancholy.
title: Sleepy Dog

prompt: Fine droplets fall onto the glass perfume bottle and the dark gritty ground, beading and running down its side while the small green shoots tremble. The camera arcs slowly around the bottle from left to right. A cool highlight slides along the glass edges. Moody, fresh, cinematic.
title: Bottle In Rain

prompt: She tilts her chin slightly and her lips part into a small smile, making the jewelled ornaments beside her face sway and scatter sparkles. The camera drifts sideways in a slow close-up. Warm red light flares on each stone and blurs into soft glowing discs. Rich, festive, intimate.
title: Glinting Jewellery

prompt: The ears of wheat bend hard to the right in a gust, spring back and bend again, their bristles trembling. The camera holds still, low among the stalks. Flat, pale light from the overcast sky keeps the gold of the crop muted. Windswept, rural, restless.
title: Wheat In Wind

prompt: The stream of orange juice keeps falling into the glass, swirling at the bottom and rising steadily with small bubbles along the edge. The camera pushes in slowly towards the glass. Golden backlight glows through the juice and glints on the curved rim. Bright, fresh, appetising.
title: Juice Pour

prompt: The red-haired woman in the beige trench coat runs her raised hand through her hair, shifts her weight onto the other boot and turns her gaze towards the lens. The camera tilts up slowly from her boots to her face. Soft street light warms the coat. Confident, editorial, poised.
title: Trench Coat Pose

prompt: The eye blinks slowly, then the iris shifts to look off to the side and the fine lines around the lid crease and relax. The camera holds still in extreme close-up. Warm side light moves faintly across the lashes and leaves a bright point on the pupil. Thoughtful, human, quiet.
title: Eye Detail

prompt: The orange and red wildflowers nod on their thin stems, bobbing out of rhythm with one another as the grass around them ripples. The camera slides slowly to the left at flower height. Soft daylight keeps the green meadow behind blurred and even. Light, carefree, summery.
title: Meadow Blooms

prompt: The hand tips the glass teapot and amber tea streams into the small glass cup, swirling as it fills while a little steam rises. The camera tilts down to follow the pour. Pink and violet light from the table glows through the tea and the glass. Cosy, colourful, unhurried.
title: Glass Teapot Pour

prompt: The mirrored conifers waver gently as faint ripples cross the water, and the mist drifts slowly from right to left. The camera holds still. Grey, diffuse light brightens a touch near the centre as the fog thins. Silent, cold, dreamlike.
title: Misty Reflection

prompt: The orange and black butterfly opens and closes its wings in slow beats while the yellow flower beneath it sways under its weight. The camera pushes in gently towards the wings. Sunlight flickers across the blurred blooms behind. Delicate, bright, cheerful.
title: Butterfly Rest

prompt: Faint wisps of steam rise from the fresh baguettes on the wire racks as a baker passes in soft focus behind them. The camera tracks slowly from left to right along the shelf. Warm overhead light catches the scored, golden crusts. Homely, busy, inviting.
title: Bakery Racks

prompt: The feet in white trainers rise onto their toes, stretch and settle back down on the pavement, then take a small step forward. The camera holds still at ground level. Cool, even daylight keeps the shadows under the shoes soft and short. Limber, casual, ready.
title: Street Steps

prompt: The wind lifts the loose strands of her hair and she reaches up to tuck them back, keeping her calm gaze on the lens. The camera holds still at chest height. Hazy coastal light stays soft on her face while the waves behind roll in and break. Natural, grounded, serene.
title: Sea Breeze Portrait

prompt: The camera mounted on the gimbal pans smoothly to the right, then tilts down as the stabiliser arms adjust with small precise movements. The viewpoint circles it slowly from below. The blue glow behind pulses faintly and edges the black body with light. Technical, sleek, precise.
title: Gimbal Glide

prompt: The dark stream from the pot keeps pouring into the beige mug, the level climbs and a curl of steam lifts off the surface. The camera pushes in slowly towards the mug on its wooden coaster. The screen behind shifts its warm glow across the desk. Comfortable, focused, mid-morning.
title: Desk Pour

prompt: The two flames waver and lengthen above the pool of molten wax, and tiny ripples spread around each wick. The camera drifts in a slow circle above the candle. Vivid blue light shimmers across the liquid surface while the flame tips stay pink and white. Hypnotic, cool, meditative.
title: Blue Wax Glow

prompt: The puffy white clouds slide steadily to the right, swelling at their tops and fraying at the edges. The camera tilts up a little as they pass. Bright midday sun keeps the cloud faces crisp against the saturated blue. Fresh, optimistic, open.
title: Fair Weather Sky

prompt: The dark leaves on the branch flutter and the whole bough dips and lifts as wind passes through it. The camera holds still, looking up. The flat grey sky behind lightens slowly from one side, sharpening the silhouette. Spare, quiet, contemplative.
title: Branch Silhouette

prompt: The tabby cat lifts its amber eyes from the ground to the lens, its ears swivel forward and its whiskers twitch. The camera pushes in slowly on its face. Cool, teal-tinted window light flickers faintly across its striped fur. Alert, curious, quiet.
title: Watchful Tabby

prompt: The dog's nose twitches as it sniffs the air, its jowl quivers and it blinks once in profile. The camera slides slowly along its muzzle from nose to eye. Bright, clean studio light stays even against the white background. Gentle, attentive, endearing.
title: Beagle Profile

prompt: A petal of the white rose loosens and settles on the tabletop while the stems in the glass vase sway a fraction. The camera glides slowly from the rose towards the perfume bottle. Soft daylight moves across the bottle and glows through the golden liquid. Elegant, clean, feminine.
title: Perfume And Rose

prompt: The hanging gold chains swing gently and turn, their links knocking softly against one another above the red cloth. The camera tracks slowly across the pile of jewellery. Warm light glints from link to link in travelling sparkles. Opulent, tactile, glittering.
title: Gold Chains

prompt: The ripe crop rolls in long waves as gusts sweep across the field, each band of stalks bowing and rising in turn. The camera glides forward slowly above the grain. Low golden sun brushes the tips and leaves darker troughs between the swells. Vast, warm, soothing.
title: Golden Waves

prompt: The jug tips further and orange juice spills in a smooth arc into the empty glass, splashing against the bottom and climbing the sides. The camera holds still. Bright, shadowless white light keeps the scene clean and makes the juice glow. Crisp, simple, refreshing.
title: First Splash

prompt: The woman in the pale green dress turns slowly on the spot, letting the wide sleeves and hem swing out, then looks back over her shoulder. The camera pushes in from full length to waist height. Soft studio light stays even on the olive backdrop. Graceful, minimal, composed.
title: Green Dress Sway

prompt: The closed eyelid flutters, then opens slowly as the pale lashes lift and a few blonde strands stir across the brow. The camera holds still in extreme close-up. Soft, warm light creeps across the freckled skin as though the sun is rising. Tender, waking, peaceful.
title: Eyes Opening

prompt: The pink cosmos flowers bob and lean on their tall stems, petals quivering as each gust passes. The camera tilts up slowly along the stalks towards the open blooms. Pale, misty light from the grey sky keeps the colours soft. Airy, delicate, wistful.
title: Cosmos Stems

prompt: Both metal teapots tilt and two streams of tea fall into the glass as steam billows up between the pourers' hands. The camera pushes in slowly towards the glass. Daylight from the windows behind catches the steam and gleams on the polished pots. Convivial, warm, ritual.
title: Twin Teapots

prompt: The two birds paddle slowly across the still water, leaving thin trails, while fog drifts past the small floating jetty. The camera holds still. Grey light thickens and thins as the mist moves, hiding and revealing the horizon. Hushed, solitary, tranquil.
title: Fog On The Lake

prompt: The dark butterfly fans its wings and probes the pink and yellow blooms, shifting its feet as the flower heads rock. The camera arcs gently around it. Dappled sunlight shimmers in the green blur behind. Lively, colourful, summery.
title: Wings On Zinnia

prompt: A light dusting of flour drifts off the round loaves and settles into the weave of the basket. The camera tilts slowly down across the crusts, close enough to see every crack. Soft daylight slides over the floured tops and deepens the shadows between them. Wholesome, rustic, comforting.
title: Rustic Loaves

prompt: The feet in green and yellow trainers bounce, tap heel then toe and shuffle sideways in a quick dance step. The camera holds still at ankle height. Warm, even light on the stone wall behind keeps the colours of the shoes bold. Playful, rhythmic, energetic.
title: Trainer Bounce

prompt: She turns her head slowly from profile towards the lens, a few strands of dark hair slipping across her cheek, and gives a faint smile. The camera circles her a few degrees. Warm, low sunlight flares softly through the blurred foliage behind her. Calm, golden, reflective.
title: Quiet Profile

prompt: Steam swirls lazily above the coffee in the white cup, twisting into thin threads before fading out. The camera rotates slowly overhead, keeping the cup centred. Soft light from one side lengthens the shadow of the handle across the teal surface. Mellow, graphic, slow.
title: Teal Cup Steam

prompt: The flame on the orange pillar candle sways, dips and straightens, and a bead of wax rolls down its side. The camera pushes in slowly towards the wick. The blurred candles behind glimmer and their glow pulses gently. Snug, festive, peaceful.
title: Pillar Candle

prompt: The heaped clouds tower and drift left, their bases flattening as wisps of higher cloud streak past above them. The camera holds still over the dark treeline. Sunlight sweeps across the cloud faces while the trees stay in silhouette. Dramatic, wide, brisk.
title: Clouds Over Treeline

prompt: The leafy treetops toss and sway, their branches bending apart and closing again as the breeze picks up. The camera pans slowly to the right across the canopy. Bright, hazy daylight flashes on the upturned leaves. Breezy, green, easygoing.
title: Treetop Breeze

prompt: The ginger cat tracks something overhead, its head tipping from side to side, pupils widening and whiskers pushed forward. The camera holds still. Soft garden light warms its fur while the pink and green background shimmers out of focus. Curious, bright, endearing.
title: Ginger Cat Gaze

prompt: The brindle dog's side rises and falls with slow breaths, an ear flicks and its eyelids flutter without opening. The camera creeps in at ground level. Dull afternoon light shifts slightly as something passes beyond the parked car. Sleepy, still, tender.
title: Dozing Dog

prompt: The amber liquid inside the perfume bottle rocks gently as though the table has been nudged, and the cap catches a turning glint. The camera rises slowly from the tabletop to the top of the bottle. Light sweeps across the glass against the red wall. Polished, bold, luxurious.
title: Amber Bottle Glint

prompt: The ring turns slowly on the spot so the pale blue stone flashes from facet to facet. The camera pushes in to macro distance on the setting. A cool teal beam sweeps across the band and the row of beads behind it. Precise, cool, elegant.
title: Blue Gem Ring

prompt: The mottled clouds slide slowly across the sky and the few tall stalks at the horizon bend in the wind. The camera tilts gently upward from the field. Shafts of sunlight fan out through the haze and brighten. Spacious, hazy, peaceful.
title: Hazy Field Sky

prompt: The hand keeps tilting the bottle and green juice runs into the glass, frothing lightly as it rises past the halfway mark. The camera descends slowly from overhead towards the glass. Bright daylight stays clean on the marble, limes and cucumber slices. Fresh, healthy, vivid.
title: Green Juice Pour

prompt: The woman in the orange dress slides her hands down the wall, tosses her hair back and lifts her eyes while the ruffles stir in a breeze. The camera pushes in slowly from the side. Warm sun rakes across the rough plaster and her shoulder. Sultry, sunlit, confident.
title: Orange Ruffles

prompt: Her closed eyes open slowly, the lashes lifting together, and her gaze settles straight ahead before her brows soften. The camera holds still. Soft frontal light picks up the shimmer on her eyelids as they move. Serene, deliberate, striking.
title: Lashes Lift

prompt: The clusters of pink flowers jostle and nod as the wind pushes through them, single petals trembling at the edges. The camera slides slowly to the right through the blooms. Bright sun flickers across the petals and the green behind. Cheerful, vivid, breezy.
title: Pink Phlox

prompt: The thin stream of tea continues from the dark ceramic teapot into the glass cup, which fills and releases a faint haze of steam. The camera drifts down from the pot to the cup. Hazy backlight from the window glows through the rising vapour. Slow, soft, thoughtful.
title: Dark Teapot Stream

prompt: The bird glides across the lake and its wake spreads through the reflected clouds, bending them into slow ripples. The camera tilts up gradually from the water to the distant hills. Sunlight breaks through and brightens the surface in patches. Wide, clear, restful.
title: Mirror Lake

prompt: The white butterfly clings to the purple flower, flexing its veined wings as the stem arcs and rebounds in the wind. The camera follows the swaying bloom with a gentle handheld drift. Soft, overcast light keeps the meadow pale and even. Fragile, quiet, pastoral.
title: White Wings

prompt: A serrated knife enters from the top edge and saws slowly through the dark crust, sending crumbs tumbling down the side of the loaf. The camera holds still in tight close-up. Warm side light picks out every ridge and flake. Earthy, crisp, satisfying.
title: Crust Close-Up

prompt: Two hands reach down, pull the laces of the nearer white trainer tight and tie a bow, then the foot taps the floor twice. The camera pushes in slowly at floor level. Cool indoor light gleams on the polished grey floor. Clean, sporty, purposeful.
title: White Trainers

prompt: Strands of her fair hair whip across her glasses in the wind, she breathes in and slowly opens her eyes. The camera holds still, close on her face. Soft grey daylight stays even while the lenses catch a passing reflection. Introspective, windswept, calm.
title: Hair Across Glasses

prompt: The light panel on its stand brightens in steps, then its head tilts down a few degrees as the stand settles. The camera orbits slowly around it. The panel's glow spreads over the display wall behind and flares softly in the lens. Tidy, technical, methodical.
title: Light Panel Glow

prompt: The tall flame on the orange candle stretches upward, wavers and narrows to a point while the blurred flame beside it throbs. The camera holds still. Amber light breathes across the dark wooden surroundings with each flicker. Solemn, warm, still.
title: Tall Flame

prompt: The small soft clouds float upward and to the right, slowly changing shape and dissolving at their edges. The camera holds still, pointed straight at the sky. Even sunlight keeps the blue smooth and the cloud tops gently lit. Light, simple, dreamy.
title: Soft Sky Drift

prompt: The dry brown leaves quiver and twist on their stalks while the green leaves around them rustle, and one brown leaf breaks free and falls. The camera pushes in slowly through the branches. Spots of sun flicker across the foliage. Seasonal, crisp, bittersweet.
title: Autumn Leaf Tremble

prompt: The grey and white cat shifts its yellow-green eyes towards the lens, narrows them and flicks one ear back. The camera slides slowly from its whiskers up to its eye. Dim, soft light from the left glistens on its pink nose. Cool, aloof, watchful.
title: Grey Cat Stare

prompt: The tan dog turns its head from left to right, ears pricking, and its breath shows as a small cloud in the cold air while a few snowflakes fall. The camera holds still. Bright, flat winter light bounces off the snowbanks. Crisp, alert, wintry.
title: Dog In Snow

prompt: The faceted glass bottle rotates slowly on its edge as a fine thread of liquid falls onto its cap and beads across the surface. The camera rises slowly along the bottle. Soft light travels through the facets and scatters small gleams on the pink backdrop. Glossy, sweet, refined.
title: Crystal On Pink

prompt: The raised hand lets the gold chain slip through its fingers so it swings and turns in the air. The camera pushes in from the room towards the hand. The table lamp behind glows steadily and its light runs along the swaying links. Warm, private, unhurried.
title: Chain In Hand

prompt: The green crop ripples in broad waves that run from the foreground towards the far trees, and the clouds drift slowly overhead. The camera rises gently from the stalks to take in the horizon. Cloud shadows slide across the field. Fresh, open, restful.
title: Green Field Ripple

prompt: The clear stream keeps falling into the tall glass, churning into bubbles and climbing the sides in a twisting column. The camera holds still. A hard white highlight runs down the glass and shimmers on the turbulence against the black. Stark, elegant, precise.
title: Monochrome Pour

prompt: The man in the white hoodie rolls his shoulders, then turns his head to glance back over his left shoulder. The camera pushes in slowly from behind. Soft, even light stays flat on the wooden wall and picks out the folds of the fabric. Understated, cool, casual.
title: Back Turned

prompt: The arching sprays of tiny white flowers bounce and sway, dipping in and out of the focal plane. The camera drifts slowly to the left among the stems. Shaded green light is broken by small glints of sun on the petals. Delicate, cool, tranquil.
title: White Sprays

prompt: A thin stream pours into the glass on the table, the red drink ripples and rises, and the blurred figure behind leans forward slightly. The camera pushes in slowly towards the glass. Soft café light glints on the ridged sides and the white tabletop. Sociable, mellow, relaxed.
title: Red Drink Ripple

prompt: Slow ripples cross the dark water and stretch the pink glow of the sky between the black shapes of the trees. The camera drifts forward just above the surface. The band of colour fades from rose towards violet as the light goes. Still, deep, nocturnal.
title: Dusk Reflection

prompt: The butterfly perched on the yellow flower opens its folded wings a little, closes them and shifts as the stem sways. The camera tilts down slowly from the blurred blooms above to the flower it sits on. Sunlight dapples the green behind. Sunny, light, joyful.
title: Yellow Bloom Visitor

prompt: The pale bread rolls swell gently on the tray, their tops slowly turning golden as heat haze shimmers above them. The camera slides along the row from left to right. The deep orange glow of the oven strengthens. Warm, patient, mouth-watering.
title: Oven Rise

prompt: The feet in black trainers push off beside the car, step forward across the white road marking and walk out of the right side of the frame. The camera holds still at ground level. Muted daylight glints faintly on the wheel rim. Urban, cool, low-key.
title: Kerbside Step

prompt: The wind sweeps her dark hair across her face and ripples the red patterned dress; she brushes the strands aside and smiles. The camera pushes in from waist height to her face. Bright, hazy light off the sea softens the green headland behind. Free, breezy, joyful.
title: Coastal Wind

prompt: The dark ornate cup turns slowly on the spot and a pale wisp of steam climbs out of it into the blackness. The camera holds still. A single narrow light sweeps around the rim and along the handle as it rotates. Mysterious, minimal, dramatic.
title: Cup In Darkness

prompt: The two flames bend sharply to one side as though someone has breathed on them, shrink, then recover and stand upright. The camera pushes in slowly towards the jar candle on the left. Soft peach light wobbles across the fabric behind. Soothing, gentle, homely.
title: Jar Candles

prompt: The grey-bottomed clouds churn and part, widening the ragged patch of blue between them. The camera tilts up slowly. Sunlight breaks through the gap and whitens the edges of the cloud while the undersides stay heavy. Changeable, brisk, hopeful.
title: Cloud Break

prompt: The black leaves flutter and spin on their thin twigs while the branches bob against the white sky. The camera pans slowly to the left. The bright background flickers through the moving leaves, keeping the contrast hard. Graphic, restless, poetic.
title: Ink Leaves

prompt: The cat lifts its head from the ground, looks left, then right, and its ears swivel after each sound. The camera holds still at its eye level. Shaded evening light stays low and green, with a dim sheen on its fur. Wary, quiet, observant.
title: Garden Cat

prompt: The dog's wet nose flares and wrinkles as it sniffs, the whiskers on its muzzle twitching with each breath. The camera pushes in to macro distance. Soft outdoor light glistens on the nose while the paving and hedge behind stay blurred. Funny, curious, affectionate.
title: Sniffing Nose

prompt: Water surges up around the tilted crystal bottle, throwing droplets into the air before spilling over the edge of the glass stand. The camera circles slowly at tabletop height. Light sparkles through the splash and the pink facets. Glamorous, lively, fresh.
title: Perfume Splash

prompt: The clasped hands release the chain a little and the pendant swings from side to side like a pendulum in front of the white skirt. The camera follows the pendant with a slow tilt down. Soft window light gleams along the links. Quiet, mesmerising, gentle.
title: Swinging Pendant

prompt: The feathery golden plumes bow together in the wind and rise again, the nearest one sweeping across the foreground. The camera slides slowly to the right through the grasses. Warm low sun glows through the seed heads. Soft, rustling, autumnal.
title: Reed Plumes

prompt: A hand lifts the bottle and pours orange juice into the empty glass beside it, then sets the bottle back down. The camera pushes in slowly across the table. Striped sunlight through the blinds slides over the tabletop and lights up the juice. Calm, moody, morning.
title: Blind Shadows

prompt: The model in yellow trousers changes pose, resting her chin on her hand and then stretching one leg out, as the photographer in the foreground leans in. The camera edges forward past the photographer's shoulder. A flash pops against the mint backdrop. Busy, creative, upbeat.
title: On Set Pose

prompt: She blinks slowly and her eyes crease at the corners as a smile begins, a few braids swinging at the edge of the frame. The camera holds still in close-up. Soft frontal light keeps a bright catchlight in each eye. Warm, direct, self-assured.
title: Direct Gaze

prompt: The small daisy-like flowers whip to the right in a strong gust and spring back, their white petals fluttering. The camera holds still, low to the ground. Hard midday sun stays bright on the petals against the sandy blur behind. Bright, breezy, uncomplicated.
title: Chamomile Sway

prompt: Golden tea streams into the clear glass cup, swirling around the base and rising towards the rim as steam begins to lift. The camera pushes in slowly from the side. Bright white backlight shines through the tea and the saucer. Pure, light, refreshing.
title: Clear Cup Pour

prompt: Fine ripples travel across the water from left to right, breaking the reflected clouds into shifting bands. The camera glides slowly forward over the surface. Silver light flashes on the ripple crests as the reflection darkens and brightens. Meditative, fluid, cool.
title: Rippled Sky

prompt: The pale green butterfly hangs from the magenta flower, wings folded, then lets go and flutters to the next bloom. The camera follows it with a gentle pan. Soft daylight keeps the magenta petals saturated against the grey-green stems. Light, fleeting, gentle.
title: Brimstone On Magenta

prompt: Steam curls off the tall golden loaf at the front of the basket and a few crumbs drop from its crust onto the weave. The camera pans slowly across the rolls behind it. Soft light from above moves over the glazed tops. Generous, warm, appetising.
title: Basket Of Bread

prompt: A breath of wind catches the dandelion clock and its seeds peel away one by one, floating off to the right on their fine parachutes. The camera pushes in slowly towards the seed head. Dull, even daylight holds on the grey path while the dark trees behind stay blurred. Fragile, fleeting, hushed.
title: Dandelion Seeds

prompt: The woman in the grey flat cap tilts her head, her smile widens and a loose strand of blonde hair stirs against her collar. The camera drifts in from waist height towards her face. Soft overcast light filters through the bare trees behind her. Friendly, relaxed, outdoorsy.
title: Woodland Smile

prompt: The golden puppy lying on the patterned rug lifts its head, pants with its tongue out and wags its tail, then stretches its front paws forward. The camera lowers gently to its eye level. Bright indoor light stays soft on its pale fur and the white room behind. Sweet, playful, sunny.
title: Puppy On Rug

prompt: The kitten licks its raised paw in quick strokes, pauses to look at the lens with wide eyes, then goes back to washing. The camera holds still. Soft light from the left shapes its fur in greys while the background falls away to black. Tender, small, absorbed.
title: Kitten Grooming

prompt: Steam coils up from the orange mug in thick, slow plumes that drift towards the window and fade. The camera rises slowly from the tabletop to the rim. Sunlight through the glass backlights the steam and moves the leafy shadows across the table. Bright, cosy, restful.
title: Orange Mug Steam
